thread:
Leah (AE): Heads-up: New ask from MeridianHealth for the POC. Auditor wants a single ZIP with: SOC2/ISO "in-scope" manifest, network/data-flow diagrams showing where PHI is processed, pen-test attestation signed by Redwood, and an itemized cost delta for using reserved staging hosts vs ephemeral. They need it by Wed COB.

Diego (PreSales): I can assemble the diagram and manifest. Questions: do we call out internal infra names or map to generic labels? Auditor asked for asset identifiers to match inventory.

Nia (Security): For SOC2/ISO artifacts we provide an "in-scope assets" CSV that references our CMDB IDs. We should not expose internal hostnames; map to asset IDs + roles (e.g., model-server-01 -> CMDB-12345, role: inference). Pen-test attestation: Security can provide the standard template and sign operational attestation. Legal must approve any change to indemnity language. Signed attestation available ~72 hours after final vendor report.

Marcus (Pricing): Reserved staging hosts: short-term reservations carry a premium; rough delta is +30% for dedicated tenancy on A100-class. Ephemeral burst is billed at usage rates and avoids commit. I can produce a 3-line table: small/med/large POC capacity with cost comparison. Need expected peak rps and session lengths.

Leah (AE): Meridian specifically asked whether we can provide the pen-test letter before the vendor report is final. Whats our stance?

Nia (Security): We cannot issue a final attestation without the vendor report. We can, however, issue a provisional attestation stating a test was scheduled/completed pending final report and that findings will be included in the final attestation. But Legal prefers the final signed attestation only after report close-out.

Diego (PreSales): On diagrams: I'll create a main flow PNG and a CSV manifest mapping services -> CMDB IDs -> CIDRs. Example SG snippet for manifest:
```
service,cmdb_id,cidr,role
inference-gateway,CMDB-9876,10.20.1.0/24,ingress
model-hosts,CMDB-9880,10.20.2.0/24,inference
kv-cache,CMDB-9900,10.20.3.0/24,cache
```
I'll upload PNG + exported drawio and CSV by EOD today.

Deploy Bot: Created folder /evidence/meridian-4312345678/ and uploaded pen-test-attestation-draft.pdf (owner: Nia).

Nia (Security): Uploaded draft. I'll prepare the CSV asset list and a 1-page KMS/certificate statement (CN + issuer + redacted thumbprint). We will not share private keys or internal rotation scripts. If Meridian requests CT logs for public certs we can include entries; for private certs provide thumbprint only.

Marcus (Pricing): Leah, if they opt for dedicated staging, Ill include a pro-rated monthly commit and the delta to move to production. Also note potential SLA differences.

Leah (AE): Action items: Diego -> diagram + CSV manifest (EOD). Nia -> pen-test attestation draft + KMS/cert one-pager (tomorrow). Marcus -> cost delta table (EOD). I will bundle and send to Meridian on Thurs AM to meet Wed COB ask (tight). If they push for vendor full report earlier, we'll need signed NDA & vendor approval (adds ~2 business days).

Nia (Security): One more note: if customer requests vendor-signed full report, vendor may redact exploit details; expect summary-level findings.

Leah (AE): Thanks team. I'll escalate timeline to Meridian if anything slips. :thumbsup:
